description:
## Why This Exists

The now_rfc2822() / epoch_to_rfc2822() helper is implemented three times: once in tests/e2e_data_flow.rs (now_rfc2822), once in tests/fault_store_errors.rs (epoch_to_rfc2822), and the implementation in stoa_core::util::epoch_to_rfc2822 already exists. The test helpers reinvent the wheel and are not tested themselves.

## Acceptance Criteria

Remove the local now_rfc2822/epoch_to_rfc2822 functions from both test files. Use stoa_core::util::epoch_to_rfc2822 directly.
title: e2e test: now_rfc2822() duplicated in e2e_data_flow.rs and fault_store_errors.rs
